create_coco_dataset_loader: create a COCO dataset loader from a JSON annotation file to access images, categories, and annotations
get_filtered_annotation_ids: get annotation ids filtered by image ids, category ids, area range, and crowd label
convert_segmentation_to_binary_mask: convert polygon or RLE segmentation annotations to a binary mask numpy array
load_algorithm_results_api: load algorithm prediction results from a JSON file and return a COCO API object for evaluation
display_annotation_visualization: display segmentation polygons, masks, or keypoints annotations on a matplotlib figure
